title: v17 verification — rollup of all 17 defects found working the #3909 checklist
body:
Rollup of every defect found while working the v17 verification checklist on #3909. **17 issues, all open.** Filed across four verification runs against `main` @ `1ee48bc60` (post-`17.0.0-rc.1`), driving a real showcase boot plus purpose-built probe stacks as two live principals.

This issue exists so the RC train has one place to see the damage and decide what blocks exit. Each item below is independently reproducible — the linked issue carries the exact requests and responses.

*(Correction to the run-4 comment on #3909, which said "13 defects" — the count is 17. The grouped list there was right; the total was a miscount.)*

---

## 1 — Security & data integrity (8)

These change who can read or write what, or leave the audit record untrue.

- [ ] #4467 — **`/analytics/query` ignores record-level scoping.** A member with shares on 2 of 5 private notes counts 5, and `dimensions:["title"]` returns the *titles* of the 3 they cannot read. Any authenticated caller who reaches `/analytics` can enumerate field values of every row of any cube-exposed object, past OWD, sharing rules and RLS. **The most serious finding of the verification.**
- [ ] #4433 — **A sharing rule's materialized grants are never withdrawn.** Deactivating the rule does not revoke them — not on the next record touch, not after a full restart.
- [ ] #4434 — **`DELETE /sharing/rules/:idOrName` 500s for both address forms**, so the rule cannot be deleted either. Compounds #4433: an over-granting rule is unrecoverable from the API surface.
- [ ] #4447 — **`created_at` is client-writable** on an ordinary PATCH and persists. `updated_at` and `created_by` are correctly protected; the audit anchor is the one that is not.
- [ ] #4441 — **A `lookup` accepts an id that exists nowhere**, including `sys_position_permission_set.permission_set_id` — a grant row can point at nothing while the audience-anchor gate has to resolve that set to judge it.
- [ ] #4462 — **An object mapped to an unreachable datasource silently reads/writes the DEFAULT store.** Boot succeeds, the datasource name never appears in the log, `/ready` stays 200, and the data lands in a different database than the one declared.
- [ ] #4477 — **Screen-flow `resume` performs no server-side validation.** Missing required fields, and undeclared keys, all complete the run. A client posting straight to `resume` bypasses every `required` the flow author declared.
- [ ] #4466 — **An admin override of a staffed approver slate is recorded as an ordinary approval.** `sys_approval_action` has no override column, so bypassing designated approvers is byte-identical to being one.

## 2 — Contract & envelope (6)

Declared contracts that do not hold, or refusals that break the ADR-0112 envelope.

- [ ] #4431 — A sandbox **capability denial answers 400** as a deliberate rejection; the crash contract (#3951) says 500. The `SandboxError:` debug prefix also reaches the client.
- [ ] #4435 — **PATCH/DELETE of a nonexistent record answer 200 success** (`record: null` / `success: true`) where GET correctly 404s. `deleteMany` reports every typo'd id as deleted.
- [ ] #4436 — The **unsupported-filter-operator refusal ships without `error.code`** and leaks the `[sql-driver]` prefix.
- [ ] #4437 — An **analytics measure naming a missing field 500s with `SQLITE_ERROR`** instead of a 400 naming the field.
- [ ] #4432 — **Meta overlay writes do not normalize the type segment**: plural and singular land in different namespaces, one overlay row shadows the entire code-authored listing, and the row cannot be deleted by either spelling.
- [ ] #4455 — **`os migrate value-shapes` misses a `lookup` holding an embedded record object** — the exact case its own docstring names — because the reference shape is `z.string().min(1)`. The gate then closes on evidence it never gathered.

## 3 — UI & docs (3)

- [ ] #4475 — **Every Setup System Overview KPI tile reads 0** (Users 0 vs 4, Sessions 0 vs 16). The dataset path lowers an all-time range to `WHERE created_at = $1`. First screen an operator sees.
- [ ] #4478 — **Quorum progress and per-group chips do not render**, though the server sends `minApprovals`, per-approver `group`, and a pre-rendered `"Committee Sign-off (2 of 3)"`. Fix belongs in objectui #2811; no framework change needed.
- [ ] #4476 — **Nine doc passages date the #4286 query-surface removals to spec 18** — they ship in 17. A reader on 16 plans the break a major too late.

---

## Suggested triage for RC exit

**Should block:** #4467 (aggregate disclosure past every access control), and the #4433 + #4434 pair (an over-granting sharing rule with no in-product way to revoke it). Both are security properties the v17 release page actively advertises as fixed.

**Strong candidates:** #4447 and #4477 — both let a caller do something the declared contract forbids, and both are one-line-of-defence gaps rather than degraded UX. #4462 lands data in the wrong database silently.

**Can ship with, worth fixing soon:** the envelope group (#4431, #4435, #4436, #4437) — wrong status codes and missing `error.code`, all mechanical. #4432 and #4455 are narrower but both let a surface report success it did not achieve.

**Docs/UI:** #4476 is cheap and should land before RC exit because it misinforms upgraders. #4475 and #4478 are visible but non-destructive.

## Two things that are not defects, listed so they are not re-litigated

- **`/graphql` discovery slot.** The route correctly 404s, but discovery still reports `services.graphql` as an unavailable slot whose message invites someone to implement it — for a surface v17 deliberately removed, and contradicting the docs sweep's own reduction to 16 services. Whether to drop the slot or reword the remedy is a design call, so no issue was filed. Raised here for a decision.
- **Two stale checklist claims on #3909.** The seeds item promises a `Seeds: X inserted · Y updated · Z skipped` banner that does not exist (the code deliberately collapses those into one count and uses `·` to separate *sources*); the `os migrate meta` item's "rewrites all three" reads as an in-place codemod, but it rewrites the stack snapshot (`--out`), not TypeScript sources. Both are checklist-text errors, not code defects.

Tracker: #3909 — 48 of 59 items verified; the 11 remaining are annotated inline with the issue blocking each.
